verdict.rationale: BigQuery supports DML DELETE statements, table/dataset-level expiration, time travel windows, and IAM controls for access, which give admins levers to manage retention and deletion, but there is no dedicated documentation on AI-native data retention policies, automated deletion workflows, or privacy-specific controls tailored to AI agents/data used in model training. missing for 10: explicit retention policy configuration docs, AI-specific data deletion/opt-out controls, independent verification of deletion effectiveness.
